name: Tile-based Gaussian Sorting with Comparison-Free Sorter
definition: A hardware sorting module that outputs the current maximum value in a linear sorting delay, tailored for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to match the one-point-at-a-time consumption of alpha-blending.
summary: Tile-based Gaussian Sorting with Comparison-Free Sorter is a hardware module for 3D Gaussian Splatting that outputs maximum depth values in linear delay, avoiding logarithmic priority-queue operations.
